captions_note: the box carries those words: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while the box is up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: TEXT is what the speaker says they type or tell the AI, in their words. APP only when they name the app (its real logo from assets/icons)

the user's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (font, weight, tracking, case, ink, accent) before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Reestilizar las palabras de un efecto)
steps: edit TEXT, APP and LABEL in the CLIP block (get_icon.py "<app>" first when the app's logo is missing)
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the timings, the place, the snapshot times and the caption window
hf snapshot --at <times build.py printed>      # LOOK: mid-entrance too
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
